name: Clifftop Lookout
clause: When ~ enters, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'reveal-until'; filter: Filter; found: Effect[]; rest: 'bottom-random' | 'bottom' | 'top' | 'graveyard' | 'hand' }
needs.semantics: Reveal cards from the top of your library until one matches `filter`; bind it as 'that' and run `found`, then put the remaining revealed cards where `rest` says (random order for 'bottom-random').
needs.clause: reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
